text:
sam_sales: Hi team — opening RFI thread for LatticeCare. They want a 4-week POC (Private VPC + optional on-prem HSM), capability matrix, SAML/SCIM, and tiered pricing for embeddings + streaming. Embeddings target is 80 QPS sustained. Also asked for sample SOW and KMS/key flow.

nina_se: I can take capmatrix + written responses. Quick Q: do they need on-prem HSM day 1 or will CloudHSM be ok for the POC?

omar_infra: CloudHSM OK for POC. On-prem HSM supported but requires ~3-4 week lead time for field support and logistics. For 80 QPS we recommend 5xA10 or 1-2xA100 depending on sequence length and batching. We'll use KV caching to reduce load.

leila_prod: I'll draft the pricing tiers. Proposal: POC reserved for 4 weeks at 40% off list (includes 8 support hours/week), production tiers with volume breakpoints for embeddings (0-5M, 5-20M, 20M+ tokens) and streaming per-token rates. Add-on: extended audit retention and dedicated on-call.

nina_se: Draft capmatrix snippet for the RFI (will put into spreadsheet):

Requirement | Redwood Response | Notes
Private VPC | Supported | Customer-managed peering
SAML/SCIM | Supported | SAML IdP + SCIM 2.0 provisioning
HSM Options | CloudHSM, Thales, Entrust | On-prem support with lead time
Embeddings throughput | 80 QPS target achievable | ~5xA10 or 1xA100 + batching
Streaming | Supported, low-latency streaming | Chunked responses, resumable sessions
Compliance | SOC2, ISO27001 (artifacts NDA) | FedRAMP: status note
Rollouts | Canary/A-B, version pinning | Per-route fallback policies

omar_infra: Attestation notes: SOC2 Report ID SOC2-2024-RED-012 (available under NDA), ISO27001 Cert# ISO-RED-1152. We can provide integration docs for Thales/CloudHSM. KMS flow: customer keys -> customer KMS/HSM -> Redwood Private control plane; we do not persist plaintext keys. I'll upload a diagram.

ops-bot: File uploaded by omar_infra: lattice_kms_flow_v1.png -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1756123456/lattice_kms_flow_v1.png

legal-bot: LatticeCare asked for sample NDA before we share cert artifacts. Legal recommends attaching NDA template and marking certs "NDA only".

leila_prod: For the SOW I'll include milestones: week 0 setup and connectivity, week 1 bench + baseline, week 2 optimization (batching/quant), week 3 acceptance tests (embedding recall and latency), week 4 handoff. Acceptance criteria example: embedding recall >= 0.72 on customer eval set + 95th perc streaming latency < 250ms.

sam_sales: Good. Action items: (1) @nina_se finish capmatrix + narrative answers by tomorrow AM, (2) @omar_infra attach cert IDs and KMS flow diagram and note HSM lead times, (3) @leila_prod finalize pricing + SOW one-pager. I'll package and send to LatticeCare pending NDA.

omar_infra: Uploaded HSM integration note: lattice_hsm_note.txt -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1756123456/lattice_hsm_note.txt

nina_se: Uploaded capmatrix draft: lattice_capmatrix_draft.xlsx -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1756123456/lattice_capmatrix_draft.xlsx. Flagged open items: exact egress controls, SCIM attribute mapping, and FedRAMP evidence request.

sam_sales: Thanks all. If LatticeCare requests FedRAMP proof we'll escalate to GRC — otherwise send NDA and package. Will post when sent. End of thread.
